title_sq: SHITET VILE TREKATESHE PRANE SPITALIT USHTARAK !!!

title_en: THREE-STOREY VILLA FOR SALE NEAR THE MILITARY HOSPITAL!!!
description_en: Three-story villa for sale in Laprake! The first floor is organized in a separate kitchen, a living room, two bedrooms and a toilet. Total area 104.7 m2. The second floor is organized in the corridor, in the living room and the kitchen together, two bedrooms, a toilet, and each room has access to the balcony. Total area 129.3 m2. The third floor is organized in the distribution corridor in a living room and kitchen together with two bedrooms, a bathroom and each room has access to the balcony. Total area 129.3 m2. The villa has a plot area of ​​126 m2 and a total construction area of ​​364 m2. Also, an added value of the villa is the quality of the construction, which is all insulated with a kapot system and the walls are all covered with stone wool. All the windows are double-glazed and have high quality shutters, the doors and parquet are of the latest brands. The toilets are incaso and the electrics are of the best brands that make it possible to save energy. The heating system is installed to be equipped with boilers throughout the villa. The terrace is all isolated and can be used for various family activities. The property has all the appropriate mortgage documentation. Do not hesitate to contact me for a visit to the property!
